items.title: Trials exclude the people most likely to struggle with video
items.whyItMatters: Pain outcomes are similar in trials (claims c1, c2), but people without internet, over 75 or with low digital literacy were under-represented.
items.opportunity: Measure outcomes for every starter, including non-completers, and report them by age and internet access.

items.title: No outcomes for people who stop attending
items.whyItMatters: The closest service report measured change only among completers, which overstates benefit.
items.opportunity: Contact every starter at three months for KOOS-12 by telephone if they have stopped attending.

items.title: Who declines or drops out, and why
items.whyItMatters: Declining and drop-out cluster by language, device and broadband (claims c3, c4).
items.opportunity: Purposive interview sampling that includes non-completers, people over 75 and people with limited English, with interpreters.

items.title: Remote testing set-up
items.whyItMatters: Some remote chair stand tests fail because of camera position or chair stability.
items.opportunity: Use a standard chair height and a camera check before the first test.

reevaluation: The gaps confirm a convergent mixed-methods evaluation: outcomes for all starters and interviews that deliberately include people who stopped.
summary: Four gaps on applicability, missing outcomes for non-completers, unequal access and remote testing.
